1.t: A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall-

2.t: The Unbelievers, the which there is none to ward off,-

3.t: (A Penalty) from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.

4.t: The angels and the spirit ascend unto him in a Day the measure whereof is (as) fifty thousand years:

5.t: Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment).

6.t: They see the (Day) indeed as a far-off (event):

8.t: The Day that the sky will be like molten brass,

9.t: And the mountains will be like wool,

10.t: And no friend will ask after a friend,

11.t: Though they will be put in sight of each other,- the sinner's desire will be: Would that he could redeem himself from the Penalty of that Day by (sacrificing) his children,

14.t: And all, all that is on earth,- so it could deliver him:

15.t: By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell!-

16.t: Plucking out (his being) right to the skull!-

17.t: Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right).

18.t: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from use)!

19.t: Truly man was created very impatient;-

21.t: And niggardly when good reaches him;-

22.t: Not so those devoted to Prayer;-

23.t: Those who remain steadfast to their prayer;

24.t: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right.

25.t: For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking);

26.t: And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment;

27.t: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord,-

28.t: For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity;-

29.t: And those who guard their chastity,

30.t: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed,

31.t: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors;-

32.t: And those who respect their trusts and covenants;

33.t: And those who stand firm in their testimonies;

34.t: And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship;-

35.t: Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss).

36.t: Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee-

37.t: From the right and from the left, in crowds?

38.t: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss?

39.t: By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know!

40.t: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly-

41.t: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan).

42.t: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised!-

43.t: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them),-

44.t: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised!
